title: The betrayal that made Garrus Archangel in Mass Effect 2
subject: garrus
description:
Would you have let Garrus take the shot? 👇

tags: eye for an eye mass effect

scenes.text: Omega's three biggest mercenary gangs all wanted the same man dead.
The Blue Suns, Eclipse and Blood Pack knew him only as Archangel.
It was Garrus Vakarian. After Shepard's death in 2183, he had built a small squad on Omega.
Then Lantar Sidonis gave away their hideout, and Garrus came back to find his team dead.
In 2185 Shepard fought through to him, and a gunship rocket still caught Garrus in the face.
A mission called Eye for an Eye later put Sidonis in his scope.
Whether Garrus fires is up to Shepard.
